rationale: Extend the existing governed publication-decision capability so a governed publication spec can consume an already-existing RuleCertificationCaseFixture through the generic RuleCertificationRunner, rather than being limited to the conditional co-payment binding strategy. The fixture module is restricted to the governed rule-certification namespace and the factory, fixture type, and domain are validated. No insurer-specific or waiting-period-specific publication branch is introduced.
supersession_impact: None. Existing conditional_copayment_binding_v1 publication behavior remains available and unchanged.
authority_impact: No new publication authority is introduced. The extension only supplies a second governed certification input strategy to the existing publication-decision evaluator; publication permission and authoritative publication remain governed by their existing gates.
